evals.prompt: Attack the conjecture that every differential in this filtered complex vanishes. The only current evidence is a computation through arity 5. Work on one bounded route and do not claim the conjecture from the computation.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes the claim, chooses one decisive route or counterexample search, distinguishes finite evidence from proof, and records a bounded outcome.
assertions: States exact success and failure criteria
Uses the arity-5 computation only as bounded evidence
Does not broaden to multiple unrelated routes
Reports the first unresolved implication and a uniform route or discriminating check

evals.prompt: Three consecutive attempts verified the same scalar identity in arities 2, 3, and 4. The current handoff says the next step is to compute arity 5. Run one bounded research attempt and decide what should happen next.
evals.expected_output: Pauses the case ladder, identifies which structural properties the successful cases used, formulates a candidate uniform lemma or obstruction, and permits arity 5 only if it distinguishes named alternatives or tests a genuinely new regime.
assertions: Does not recommend arity 5 merely because arity 4 succeeded
Separates uniform structural features from case-specific coincidences
Formulates the next item as a mathematical question with a uniform route or obstruction
Names what an additional finite case would discriminate if one is proposed

evals.prompt: A bounded counterexample search found a smallest counterexample and the project uses RESEARCH_LOG.md with no custom history paths. Persist the result at a natural checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: Creates one dated standalone record under research/records and appends only a compact linked outcome line to RESEARCH_LOG.md, while leaving detailed evidence in its authoritative artifact.
assertions: Uses a lowercase ASCII YYYY-MM-DD-normalized-title.md filename
Includes the title, date, kind, evidence label, strongest surviving statement, artifacts, and unresolved question in the record
Keeps the RESEARCH_LOG.md entry to a link, evidence label, and one-sentence result or blocker
Does not duplicate detailed proof or computation content in the index

evals.prompt: Correct yesterday's indexed research finding. A record with today's normalized title already exists, and RESEARCH_LOG.md also contains older long-form legacy entries. Do not undertake a repository retrofit.
evals.expected_output: Writes a separately indexed correction record with a Corrects link and collision suffix, preserves existing records and legacy log text, and reports that migration remains pending.
assertions: Creates a new correction record rather than editing the old finding
Uses the next numeric filename suffix on collision
Appends a new compact index entry without rewriting existing entries
Does not migrate legacy log prose as a side effect of the attempt
